title: Airport Master Plan - Chattanooga Metropolitan Airport
short_description: Consultancy for preparing an airport master plan for Chattanooga Metropolitan Airport.
project_scope: Preparation of an Airport Master Plan for Chattanooga Metropolitan Airport (CHA). The notice indicates airport planning services with requested disciplines including land use planning, master planning, and transportation planning. No technical building or bridge characteristics, areas, spans, or construction quantities are stated.
services: Professional airport planning services; airport master planning; land use planning; transportation planning; submission of Statement of Qualifications (SOQ).
relevance_explanation:
- Pure planning/master planning consultancy for an airport, not structural or bridge design.
- No building, bridge, roof, stadium, or special structural scope is described.
- Falls under strategic planning/consulting rather than sbp's core structural engineering services.
- No technical planning component for load-bearing structures or HOAI-like design phases is indicated.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. The document only concerns preparation of an airport master plan and provides no project size, building areas, infrastructure quantities, or implementation budget from which a realistic construction cost estimate could be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. As this is a planning consultancy procurement without disclosed budget, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified professional consultant firms and/or teams are invited to submit a Statement of Qualifications for airport planning services. Specific minimum references or qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: Chattanooga Metropolitan Airport Authority (CMAA), Chattanooga, TN, USA. Contact: Tamara Huff. Phone: 423-855-2280. Email: thuff@chattairport.com. Website: https://www.flycha.com/request-for-bids
notes: Project funding: FAA. Solicitation documents available online. Questions deadline: 07/22/2026 04:30 PM EDT. Stage: RFP/RFQ. Although categorized here as Special structures due to airport context, the actual tender is for master planning only and is not relevant for sbp's structural engineering focus.
